REMETTE Rhino --- Made of Stonewashed 14C28N steel, combining edge retention, high hardness and corrosion resistance. The folding 4.33-inch EDC knife is perfect for everyday carry, and the sophisticated gift box and practical accessories make it a great gift for men and women.


Three Deployment Modes --- This folding knife opens with a button lock, front flipper and thumb stud. As a sharp tool, it not only provides convenience for daily opening of express, packages, letters, etc., but also for decompression operations when bored.


Safety Button Lock --- The pocket knife uses ceramic ball bearings, and the base plate is added with a lining structure to fix the blade position after opening, effectively preventing the knife from accidentally closing during use.


Comfortable Grip --- Ergonomic handle with linen material provides a comfortable grip and performs well in wet conditions. The weight-saving design makes this pocket knife light to carry, yet strong and powerful at the same time.


When we are outdoors for camping, hunting, tactical survival, hiking, fishing, climbing and other activities, a sharp and durable pocket knife will solve the difficulties for us, it can carry out branch and rope cutting, and also provide security for defense.
